info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Careers Applications Documents-v1-spec
info.description: The Careers Applications Documents Listing API allows users to retrieve a comprehensive list of documents associated with career applications. This endpoint is essential for employers and HR professionals who need to access application materials for review and processing. By leveraging this API, users can streamline the recruiting process and ensure that all necessary documentation is available for evaluation. Typical use cases include screening job applicants, managing document submissions, and facilitating communication within recruitment teams.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of documents associated with applications.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch all documents related to applications in the system. You can use this to view, manage, or analyze any documents that are part of application records.
